items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: the one that I took overseas, Frank Galbraith, Willard Brown, Budd Johnson, Huey Long, John Brown on bass, Ed Cornelius, Kenny Bryant on piano.

ctx.x: This is Galbraith, Kenny Bryant, Willard Brown--I can't see the drummer, that's probably Ed Cornelius and is this Pruitt again?
